rationale: Advised against spending the remaining time on a new GNN unless PyTorch Geometric was already installed and working, on the grounds that the truncated-SVD arm is already a graph embedding and already shows the authored graph's value under that model class. The advice was superseded four minutes later when the user supplied a GPU box with 2x NVIDIA H200 NVL, 32 cores and 1.5 TB RAM, where torch 2.11.0+cu128 and torch-geometric 2.8.1 were installed and a GraphSAGE experiment was run on the committed split.
subject: P-5
title: Skip a from-scratch GNN for the remaining day
